sentences.text: Hazero Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-17 under the industry code 39000, remediation activities and other waste management services.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-17 and a first hire on 2026-10-01, with a start-up notification and a board change registered on 2026-09-28.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, and the register confidence for the entry is low.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the industry code is the only link to the thesis and the record does not show what the company does.
